title: Write src/greeting.txt
body:
## Goal
Create the file `src/greeting.txt` containing the single line `hello from perpetua`. Create no other file.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its content is exactly `hello from perpetua` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`test "$(cat src/greeting.txt)" = "hello from perpetua"`
## Context
- goal: `.session/loop-state.json` field `goal.text` names both files
## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt` (created)
